title: 第13章 变形符第14章 二楼的道童
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
李蒙可不想自己的日常生活被打扰。
他图一个散财童子的名声不就是想要远离宗门弟子间的争斗。
被宗门内的高阶修士盯上绝对不是一件好事。
虽然宗门有门规。
但规矩对很多人来说就是为了打破的。
合欢宗外门弟子将近两千。
有人的地方就会有纷争。
哪怕是被凡人称之为修仙者的山上人也不例外。
李蒙查看起了藏宝库中的东西。
要是有能够改变容貌的宝贝就好了。
“能够随意变化外形？就是你了，变形符！”
“李师兄！”
娇媚的声音突然从天空响起。
两道曼妙身影从竹林上方掠过，飞身落入了院子中。
两人身穿青色的霓裳裙。
头戴发簪，齐腰的长发在身后飘荡着。
那美丽的面貌有着七分相似。
李蒙认识两人。
是一对姐妹。
姐姐叫圣水儿。

妹妹叫圣紫儿。
姐妹俩来自赵国皇室。
听说是亲王之女。
“稀客，稀客啊，水儿师妹，紫儿师妹，你们怎么来了？”
这两位师妹李蒙自然认识。
只不过接触不多。
两姐妹来自凡人皇室。
是亲王之女，有着郡主的身份。
凡人王朝多多少少与山上人有所联系。
这修炼资源自然是不缺的。
姐妹俩的身份也不允许他们到他这里买便宜的丹药。
姐妹俩盈盈一笑，齐齐的作揖行礼。
【姓名圣水儿】
【年龄24】
【气运6000】
content_en:
Li Meng didn't want his daily life to be disturbed.
He wanted to be known as a boy who scattered wealth because he wanted to stay away from the fights among the disciples of the sect.
It is definitely not a good thing to be targeted by high-level monks in the sect.
Although the sect has rules.
But for many people, rules are meant to be broken.
There are nearly two thousand outer disciples of Hehuan Sect.
Wherever there are people, there will be strife.
Even the mountain people who are called immortal cultivators by mortals are no exception.
Li Meng checked the contents of the treasure house.
It would be great if there was a baby that could change your appearance.
"Able to change your appearance at will? It's you, transformation talisman!"
"Senior Brother Li!"
A charming voice suddenly sounded from the sky.
Two graceful figures passed over the bamboo forest and flew into the yard.
The two were wearing cyan neon skirts.
Wearing a hairpin, waist-length hair is flowing behind her.
The beautiful faces are seventy-nine similar.
Li Meng knew both of them.
They are a pair of sisters.
My sister’s name is Sheng Shui’er.
My sister's name is Sheng Zi'er.
The two sisters come from the Zhao royal family.
I heard she is the prince's daughter.
"Rare visitor, rare visitor, Junior Sister Shui'er, Junior Sister Zi'er, why are you here?"
Naturally, these two junior sisters Li Meng knew each other.
But not much contact.
Two sisters from mortal royalty.
She is the daughter of a prince and has the status of a princess.
Mortal dynasties are more or less connected to the mountain people.
There is naturally no shortage of these cultivation resources.
The identities of the two sisters also did not allow them to buy cheap elixirs from him.
The two sisters smiled and bowed in unison.
【Name Shengshui'er】
【Age 24】
【Lucky 6000】
